title: The Empty Tomb
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the women felt when they heard that Jesus was alive?
kidSafetyNotes: Easter / empty_tomb = Sunday morning JOY (sibling of the_cross). Jesus's death is gentle backstory only ('Jesus had died... laid to rest'); the weight is on resurrection wonder. Adam: 'It is still true today' kept on purpose -- the resurrection is a proclamation, not a behavior to imitate (unlike a moral). One image: the empty tomb / folded grave cloths.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
